blocks.text: # Proofpress Artifact Travel Benchmark v2
## Status

The v2 record above is immutable. The authorized successor is the separately
frozen Artifact Travel v3-r2 replicated pilot: 15 matrix cells × 3 independent
repeats = 45 cells. B uses AI Gateway
`deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash-0731` at `high`; R uses AI Gateway
`openai/gpt-5.6-terra` at `medium`; no direct/Gateway arm fallback is allowed.
B is capped at three concurrent workers and R at two. The preregistration,
case bundle, Phase 0 report, canary, and authorization record are bound under
`/Users/richardtang/.codex/worktrees/artifact-travel-v2/runs/direct-gemini/artifact-travel-v3-20260810-r3/`.

The formal execution uses three isolated Archipelago worker roots with unique
container names, compose projects, host ports, environment URLs, and output
roots. Infrastructure-only aborts may retry within the frozen budget; semantic
observations are never rerun. The active formal root is
`/Users/richardtang/.codex/worktrees/artifact-travel-v2/runs/direct-gemini/artifact-travel-v3-20260810-resume1/pilot/`.
It carries two already-completed cells from the earlier diagnostic root
without rerunning them, after correcting only the route classifier from their
immutable telemetry; it will be analyzed separately and never pooled with v2.

This is the active Proofpress product benchmark plan. The no-model v3-r2 Phase
0 run passed before paid calls, with product commit `6b843ee`, zero model calls,
and 45/45 materialized fixture cells. The explicitly authorized v3-r2 run
covered all 45 cells. Its final report has 44 scorable cells and one preserved
schema-invalid receiver observation; it is therefore not relabeled as 45/45
valid. The canonical report is
`/Users/richardtang/.codex/worktrees/artifact-travel-v2/runs/direct-gemini/artifact-travel-v3-20260810-resume1/pilot/report.json`.

The completed v3-r2 matrix is a one-case descriptive replication, not a
confirmatory efficacy result and not authorization for Phase 2. C0, C1, and C2
used the same Gateway transport and fixed B/R models. There was no direct/
Gateway arm switch; provider-level failover inside Gateway is retained as
telemetry. No arm achieved clean trusted completion or unsafe accept. C1 was
8/18 and C2 7/18 on end-to-end trusted handoff; the paired comparison was one
C2 win, two C1 wins, and 15 ties. The clean DOCX task passed only 2/9 audited
operative cells wherever a continuation reached the native audit. The one
invalid C0 receiver observation remains in the report and is excluded from
scorable denominators.

The earlier information-matched SPA v1 protocol remains an immutable
preflight-only record. It must not be run, pooled, or relabeled as v2.
## Research question and estimand

> Does the complete Proofpress portable handoff package outperform a naturally
> produced generic memory or continuity handoff at cross-workspace completion,
> verification, and safe rejection?

The primary estimand is the bundle effect `C2 − C1`. More information, explicit
decision state, portable evidence, artifact binding, and verification are all
parts of the treatment. This experiment does not identify the isolated effect
of a hash, capsule, evidence volume, or any other individual component.

`C2 − C0` is a secondary comparison against a bare artifact. It is not the sole
baseline because ordinary teams commonly leave a short handoff.
## A → B → R boundary
- **A** works in the complete source workspace and produces the current

business artifact. Independent C1 and C2 packaging stages start from the
  same frozen A artifact and source workspace.
- **B** receives the final goal and a receiver-visible package but cannot
access A's workspace, chat, memory, trajectory, scratchpad, or answer key.
- **R** receives only the exact package B received plus B's delivery. R cannot
access A, the hidden oracle, or a repaired package.
- **Oracle** is a separate harness record containing the authoritative artifact,

decision graph, evidence truth, injected fault, and acceptable dispositions.
  It is never copied into a B or R overlay.

Proofpress verification, the hidden oracle, and R are three independent layers.
Proofpress may verify integrity and declared lineage while the oracle rejects an
internally consistent but semantically false decision state.
## Conditions

| Arm | Receiver-visible handoff |
|---|---|
| `C0 artifact-only` | Final goal and identical current/stale/fork candidates; no continuity |
| `C1 conventional` | C0 plus A's natural generic summary of completed work, current state, and next action |
| `C2 proofpress-portable` | C0 plus admitted decisions and supersession, portable evidence, DOCX semantic evidence, artifact binding, native portable carrier, and capsule |

C1 is not forced to imitate Proofpress and is not intentionally degraded. All
arms use the same task, candidate artifacts, B/R tools, model capability, and
maximum budget. No arm receives padding. Package bytes, tokens, latency, tool
calls, and actual cost are reported as treatment costs.
## Package and decision interfaces
- `artifact-travel-case/v1` admits one frozen A artifact, independent C1/C2
packaging snapshots, decisions, evidence, and all input hashes.

- `artifact-travel-package/v2` is the receiver-visible package manifest.
- `receiver-disposition/v1` requires `continue`, `reject`, or `reverify`, the
selected artifact, decision/evidence use, reason codes, and output paths.
- `reviewer-verdict/v1` requires `accept`, `reject`, or `reverify`, reason codes,
and explicit identity/state/binding/evidence/fork checks.
- `fault-oracle/v1` is hidden and supplies semantic ground truth.

C2 invokes the product at commit
`6b843ee95807ccd39fcb46ca21219da73b875bf2`. The runtime records that commit,
the `proofpress.py` digest, all `inspect` and provenance-verification outputs,
and any missing telemetry as unknown rather than zero.
## Fault matrix

The frozen package states are clean, stale artifact selected, superseded
decision revived, implemented decision omitted/regressed, evidence
missing/mismatched, and artifact binding/fork mismatch. C1 and C2 run all six.
C0 runs clean, stale, and fork only, for 15 total Phase 1 cells.

The supersession and implemented-omission C2 faults are deliberately admitted
as internally consistent carrier states. Proofpress integrity may pass them;
only the hidden oracle can judge their semantics. Evidence and fork faults must
exercise real portable evidence and DOCX semantic verification failures.
## Outcomes
- **Clean trusted completion:** correct final task and artifact, no decision
regression, traceable changes, and correct R acceptance.
- **Faulted safe disposition:** B and R correctly reject or request
re-verification, give an oracle-aligned reason, and do not continue unsafely.

- **Reviewer verdict accuracy:** R's verdict and reason agree with the oracle.
- **End-to-end trusted handoff:** clean completion/acceptance or faulted safe
refusal/reverification.

Final DOCX rubric, artifact selection, decision state, regression, evidence
coverage, binding, tamper/fork detection, false reject, unsafe accept, tokens,
latency, package size, and cost remain separate reported measures.
## Current pilot interpretation

The v3-r2 report recorded no unsafe accept. On valid cells, faulted safe
disposition was C0 5/8, C1 8/18, and C2 7/18; clean trusted completion was
0/8, 0/18, and 0/18. The result is driven by task completion, not merely by
handoff syntax: clean continuations reached only 2/9 operative DOCX audit
checks, so `task_correct` and clean completion remain zero.

This means the replicated protocol produces auditable safe behavior in several
faulted states, but the runnable clean handoff/task fit is still unsolved. C2
does not show a positive task-level advantage over C1 in this matrix. The
result is descriptive single-case evidence only; it does not establish a
general Proofpress efficacy claim or justify expanding the fault matrix.
## Execution gates

Phase 0 generates all 15 fixture packages without model calls. It verifies
receiver isolation, real Proofpress portable carriers, DOCX semantic evidence,
binding, fault injection, schema validation, oracle separation, and synthetic
end-to-end scoring. A failed gate stops the protocol.

Phase 1 consumes a separately admitted case bundle. It uses one fresh
`google/gemini-3.1-pro-preview` B and one fresh `openai/gpt-5.6-terra` R per
cell, serially. The runner refuses to start unless an explicit human
authorization record matches the exact Phase 0 report, case bundle,
preregistration, and product commit hashes. Missing provider, usage, fallback,
token, or cost telemetry invalidates a cell.

At least three of the 15 R verdicts require human blind audit, emphasizing
unsafe accepts, false rejects, and reason correctness. Phase 1 completion does
not authorize Phase 2. Formal sample size is designed only after observing
pilot error space and scorer agreement.
## Benchmark boundaries

STALE becomes a separate Decision Trail Stress Suite for state, supersession,
authority, and predeclared abstention/reverification semantics. HiEviDR is a
later evidence-to-claim check. STATE-Bench is shared-memory calibration. APEX
Finance is excluded, and Harvey remains historical final-quality evidence.
None of these scores are pooled with Artifact Travel v2.

Proofpress currently has no signed identity or non-repudiation claim. This
track tests portable structure, integrity, binding, evidence coverage, state
handling, and safe disposition only.
